نحتس (form VIII)
# نَحْتَسِ (naḥtasi) /naħ.ta.si/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# نُحْتَسَ (nuḥtasa) /nuħ.ta.sa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
